title: Chapter 246
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

Dark clouds covered the moon and stars, casting a dark shadow over the land.

Under the night sky, the ground bases were brightly lit, and the searchlights tore through the dark sky. The guards were searching everywhere, and the sound of engines made the night seem as bright as day. Helicopters with searchlights looked down from above, and circles of light spots moved around the ground.

The large-scale search caused quite a lot of trouble for Han Xiao and Selina. Fortunately, Hella was familiar with the terrain. The two of them narrowly avoided team after team of guards and hid in the shadow of a metal building at the edge of the bases. They peeked out to observe, and the southern base was in sight.

There was a deep and empty area between the southern base and the base. The slope was inclined, and from their perspective, it was a downhill path. If they walked out, they would be able to see the entire base. At this time, the southern base was brightly lit, and there was a lot of noise. The searchlights swept over the slope again and again, like the white sun in the dark night.

"Sh * t, the number of people in the base has increased by a few times. With the current alert level, there is no way to not attract attention. We have to go down the slope to get to the base, and there is no way to hide. Once we are exposed, we are dead meat," Hella said in a low voice with a serious tone.

The power of the organization was like a towering mountain range. Although it had been beaten back by the six nations, it hadn't collapsed yet. It was still a colossus. On the other hand, they were alone and couldn't fight head-on. The only way was to sneak away.

Han Xiao looked at the base and said, "There are cars, guns, and cannons. Heh, it is almost the scale of a small war. Just to deal with the three of us, they are really making a big fuss."

"To be precise, it is to deal with you. We are just an extra." Hella was expressionless. She paused and asked, "Don't you have a partner to help you?"

She felt that Han Xiao's infiltration was supported by some forces, so it made sense that someone would help him escape.

However, Han Xiao's denial made her heart sink to the bottom.

"No help …" Hella could not help but ask, "Then what will you do after you escape from the headquarters? The Germinal Organization will not stop the search. Even if you leave the headquarters, you will not be able to escape from the army. "

"I'll just play it by ear." Han Xiao didn't mind. He buried his head in organizing his equipment.

Hella frowned. Since there was no support, then what was the point of following Han Xiao?

The Germinal Organization wanted him. If they went their separate ways, he and his sister would be safer. She felt that she had barely repaid his kindness by taking Han Xiao out of the headquarters through the secret passage. She didn't feel like she owed him anything by suggesting that they split up to run for their lives.

For the sake of Aurora, she had no choice but to go against her usual style and think of a safer way.

'Let's talk about it after we escape from the headquarters …'

Hella calmed down and no longer looked at Han Xiao behind her. She focused on observing the situation of the battlefield.

…

At the same time, in the southern position.

The high-powered searchlights shone on the deep slope at all times. Not a single movement could escape the observation of the position. There was a multi-barreled revolving machine gun every fifty meters, ready to spit out metal waves at any time, waiting for the enemy.

The situation of each position was transmitted to the big screen in the main control room of the headquarters through the monitoring terminal. It was divided into dozens of images for the leader to see the overall situation.

In the southern position, the players who had been recruited as players had their own camps. They were now gathered together to wait for orders. The mission [Intercept Zero] had not failed yet. In the headquarters area, including the base groups, the players were shocked when they saw the Germinal Organization's huge formation.

"We can't be of any use. If the mission succeeds, won't it be a free gift?"

"Hmm, that makes sense. This might be a plot. We can only watch and can't interfere," Elux, who was also recruited, said. Foreign players were not uncommon, so no one was surprised. No one knew that Elux was actually a real European spy.

"Hey, hey, do any of you know anything about Zero?"

At this time, a player with the ID 'White Hunt' said, "I know."

As soon as he opened his mouth, he attracted a lot of questions.

White Hunt, a quasi-first-rate player of the Temple of Gods club, had obtained information from the Guild of Gods and taken the initiative to come to the Germinal Organization to trigger [Find Zero]. Therefore, he had obtained a lot of insider information. He explained it to everyone, starting from the escape of the test subjects to secretly causing trouble to the Germinal Organization. These stories were all from the perspective of the Germinal Organization, and they immediately shocked the players.

"That sounds impressive."

"That means he is a key character in the main storyline. He escaped from the organization, subverted the Germinal Organization by himself, and became the mastermind behind the war. This is a f * cking legend!"

"Maybe he is the main character of the planet. Aiya, his favorability toward me is -30," someone exclaimed.

White Hunt smiled. "Although he is a key character in the storyline, there shouldn't be any interaction between us. Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to force us to become enemies with him."
